response:
Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

Meeting date: August 27, 2026

Key Decisions and Discussion Points

  • Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor. The team will build an internal rewrite to address multi-currency batch failures, rather than purchasing Recur or LedgerFlow.
  • The reconciliation rewrite is estimated at approximately six engineer-weeks and includes migration of the FX rounding module.
  • Karim from Platform is needed for roughly two weeks to support ledger integration.
  • Mobile receipt capture will ship as v1 without bulk-select. Bulk-select will be recorded as a fast-follow roadmap item.
  • The mobile receipt-capture design will give the OCR confidence indicator greater prominence based on user testing.
  • Vendor payout SLA remains under analysis. The target is a 48-hour p95 payout time from invoice approval, compared with the current 71-hour p95.
  • The proposed approach is to reduce the ACH batching window from 12 hours to 4 hours and add a second approver for the West Coast shift.
  • The ACH change would require approximately half a sprint of engineering effort and SRE approval because of increased monitoring overhead.
  • The audit-log retention update is deferred to Q4, as confirmed with Legal.
  • The internal admin-tool refresh remains assigned to the intern team.
  • Engineering will develop a proposal for a rotating on-call structure in response to increased bug-bash burnout.

Next Steps and Action Items

  • Marcus: Confirm Karim’s availability with his manager this week.
  • Marcus and Jenna: Complete the ACH batching-window trade-off analysis, including monitoring impact and SRE requirements, and report back next week.
  • Marcus: Propose a rotating engineering on-call structure by August 31, 2026.
  • Dan: Update the mobile receipt-capture specifications by Wednesday, September 2, 2026.
  • Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft Thursday morning for review before the Friday scope lock.
  • Sara: Present the finalized Q3 scope at the executive review on Monday.
